metadata.question: Did satellite imagery show complete cloud coverage over the Delhi metropolitan area on January 15, 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Sentinel-2 (high resolution, frequent revisit) for Delhi on 2024-01-15 - Define Delhi metropolitan area as a point or small polygon - Get images for that specific date 2. Masking strategy: - This question is ABOUT clouds, so I should NOT mask clouds - I need to check cloud coverage percentage across the entire area - Use the cloud probability band or QA band to assess cloud coverage 3. Logic: - "Complete cloud coverage" means ~100% clouds (>95% reasonable threshold) - Valid Zero (B): Images exist, clouds measured, but <95% coverage - Answer A: Images exist, >95% cloud coverage - C1: No images for that date - C2: Not applicable (we're measuring clouds, not masking them) - C3: If cloud calculation fails/invalid ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Delhi metropolitan area const delhi = ee.Geometry.Point([77.2090, 28.6139]).buffer(30000); // 30km radius // 2. Define date range for January 15, 2024 const targetDate = '2024-01-15'; const startDate = '2024-01-15'; const endDate = '2024-01-16'; // 3. Get Sentinel-2 imagery let collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(delhi) .filterDate(startDate, endDate); const collectionSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Sentinel-2 images found: ${collectionSize}`); // 4. Check if collection is empty, try Sentinel-2 Cloud Probability if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No Sentinel-2 images found for 2024-01-15'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 5. Get cloud probability data const s2Clouds = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_CLOUD_PROBABILITY') .filterBounds(delhi) .filterDate(startDate, endDate); const cloudSize = s2Clouds.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Cloud probability images found: ${cloudSize}`); if (cloudSize === 0) { // Fallback: use CLOUD_COVERAGE_ASSESSMENT from Sentinel-2 metadata const images = collection.toList(10); const firstImage = ee.Image(images.get(0)); const cloudCoverage = firstImage.get('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE').getInfo(); console.log(`Cloud coverage from metadata: ${cloudCoverage.toFixed(2)}%`); if (cloudCoverage === null || cloudCoverage === undefined) { console.log('Cloud coverage calculation failed'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Complete coverage threshold: >95% if (cloudCoverage > 95) { console.log('Complete cloud coverage confirmed (>95%)'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Incomplete cloud coverage (<95%)'); console.log('B'); } return; } // 6. Calculate average cloud probability over Delhi const cloudImage = s2Clouds.mosaic(); const cloudStats = cloudImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: delhi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const meanCloudProb = cloudStats.get('probability').getInfo(); console.log(`Mean cloud probability: ${meanCloudProb.toFixed(2)}%`); if (meanCloudProb === null || meanCloudProb === undefined) { console.log('Cloud probability calculation failed'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 7. Check pixel count const pixelCount = cloudImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: delhi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('probability').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels analyzed: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for analysis'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 8. Final determination: >95% cloud probability = complete coverage if (meanCloudProb > 95) { console.log('Complete cloud coverage confirmed (>95% probability)'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Incomplete cloud coverage (<95% probability)'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
